Full summary: Stage 1 of field-defect campaign (D1): BlackboardEntry gains origin narration|discovery; twining_record status post keeps session-record tag, findings fan-out now tagged session-finding with origin discovery
Decisions: Chose an additive origin field plus a tag split (session-finding for findings) over a lifecycle-state redesign for D1 — origin follows the rationale_source absent-means-unknown convention, needs no schema migration, and the lifecycle half of the field complaint is handled separately in D2; Chose to keep the session-record tag on the status post only rather than dropping tags entirely — the transport breadcrumb stays useful for audit while no longer covering discoveries
Findings: External consumers filtering twining_read by tags [session-record] will stop matching new findings fan-out entries (now session-finding) — intended, that filter was the D1 defect, but the field memo must call it out
